catalysts.name: Cleveland-Cliffs Inc.
catalysts.what: Cleveland-Cliffs' Q3 2026 adjusted EBITDA of $612M beat its own prior guidance of $575M, with adjusted EPS of $0.28 vs $0.21 expected; management guided Q4 2026 adjusted EBITDA to ~$715M on higher steel pricing and flagged a major Q4 debt reduction. Carried forward from 19 Oct, last day inside the 5-session window (16-22 Oct); price/cap refreshed via FMP. Shares are down sharply today (-7.0%) alongside a broad steel/materials selloff - worth watching whether the beat-and-raise thesis is fading.

catalysts.name: Datadog, Inc.
catalysts.what: Bernstein upgraded Datadog to Outperform from Market Perform on 19 Oct and raised its price target to $350 from $237, citing AI token usage growing at least 50% and saying its prior caution (tied to a large 'Born in AI' customer ARR cut) was too conservative. Datadog reports Q3 2026 results 4 Nov. Carried forward from 19 Oct, last day inside the 5-session window (16-22 Oct); price/cap refreshed via FMP. Shares are down sharply today (-5.6%) in a broad tech pullback - worth watching whether the upgrade thesis is fading.

CLF.what: North American flat-rolled and specialty steel producer, vertically integrated with its own iron ore mines, serving automotive, infrastructure and manufacturing customers.

DDOG.what: Cloud-based monitoring and analytics (observability) platform covering infrastructure, application performance, logs and security across enterprise tech stacks.
